title: 국군수송사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <Presidential Decree No. 28266, Sep. 5, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (14) Omitted.

(15) The Decree on the Armed Forces Transportation Command is partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, "ministerial-grade" is replaced with "general-officer grade (將星級)".

(16) through (90) Omitted.
